# Headway

> > Headway is the #1 most downloaded book summary app offering microlearning through curated summaries of bestselling books across personal development, business, wellness, and happiness.

Headway serves 55M+ users with an extensive library of book summaries accessible via iOS and Android apps, complemented by a corporate learning platform for team upskilling. The platform features content from leading authors like Angela Duckworth, Stephen R. Covey, and Jim Kwik, enabling users to learn key concepts in minutes through audio and text formats.

## Key Topics

- Book summaries
- Microlearning
- Personal development
- Self-improvement
- Productivity

- [Headway for Business](https://business.makeheadway.com): Headway for Business: corporate learning platform with team upskilling

## Book Collections by Topic

- [108 Best Business Books](https://makeheadway.com/library/topics/business): Business book library with negotiation, strategy, investing summaries
- [27 Personal Growth Books for Self-Improvement and Lasting Success](https://makeheadway.com/library/topics/selfimprovement): Personal growth book collection featuring Grit, 7 Habits, Limitless summaries
- [125 Best Happiness Books for a Joyful Life](https://makeheadway.com/library/topics/happiness): Curated happiness book collection for wellness and life fulfillment
- [70 Best Healing Books for Mind, Body, and Soul Transformation](https://makeheadway.com/library/topics/healing): Healing and mental health book summaries for personal transformation
